Character Creation · Step 9 of 11

Motivation

Your character wants something. Pick a general Motivation, then a specific one inside it, or roll for the category and choose from there. You can also write your own. Stick to them during play for potential bonuses.

Edge of the Empire p.95–96 Age of Rebellion p.105

Ambition

18 specifics

An internal goal the character has set for themselves — love, status, power, wealth, spiritual knowledge. Ambition is about what this character wants to become or to get, and it is often self-interested. Decide the ultimate goal and how far they will go to reach it.
